items.title: Covered by a verified licence
items.requirement: The firm holds a verified, in-force licence whose grants include this product's category and action.

items.title: Customers within the licence
items.requirement: Any customer personas the product is limited to are segments its covering licence allows.

items.title: Passes Mynt's product tests
items.requirement: The product's latest test report for its current data passed.

items.title: Feasibility analysed
items.requirement: The latest product-desk report for the current term sheet exists and its verdict is feasible.

items.title: Within regulatory limits
items.requirement: Nothing in the product's description, features or term sheet breaches a limit or requirement in the regulation recorded for it (rate or fee caps, tenor or ticket limits, mandatory features). Cite the regulation by quoting the case (mynt://case) or the regulator's page.

items.title: Claims not misleading
items.requirement: The product's name, description and features make no claim the regulation forbids or that its risk and return characteristics contradict (for example, 'guaranteed' returns on a market-linked product).

items.title: Required disclosures
items.requirement: The disclosures the product requires of developers cover what the recorded regulation says customers must be told.
